url.description: The link in the C3 File System where the generated PDF will be stored.

pdfCreator.description:
The {@link PdfCreator} which creates and returns a PDF with overall styles specified such as
page headers and footers.

pdfComponents.description: The {@link PdfComponent}s that will iteratively add content to the PDF returned by the {@link PdfCreator}.

title: Specifies the form and content of a pdf to be generated and where it will be stored when it is generated.
